summary.text: Mike Derby is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 34 who assumed office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he chairs the House Appropriations Committee in the 2025-2026 session.

paragraphs.text: Mike Derby earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of South Dakota.
His career experience includes owning a business, and he has served as board chair of the Rapid City Area Chamber of Commerce.
Derby assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 12, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the House Appropriations Committee, which he chairs, and the legislature's Appropriations Committee, where he is co-chair.
